note: Card values (health, block, resist, damage, dodge difficulty, behaviour decks, encounter line-ups) are the printed values of the 2017 core set as recorded in the public DSBG-Shuffle data set (github.com/DanDuhon/DSBG-Shuffle); threat, range, movement and targeting were read from the card faces. Range 9 stands for unlimited range. The other 2017 sets: enemy behaviour was read from re-drawn data cards and checked against a community table (work/phase7/enemy_cards_web.md); encounter line-ups are the author's, bosses' decks and special rules as the manuscript's chapter 17 states them. An encounter's crystal lizards are counted but not played.
